title: Verify Foreman can create an invoice on a work order
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Foreman role. (this role has Invoicing: View/Create and Edit - create only, no Delete).
At least one work order exists.
The work order has at least one part line where the part has been RECEIVED and has a part number (parts must be received with a part number before an invoice can be created), and the Review button on the work order has been clicked (an unclicked Review button blocks the Create Invoice button).
steps:
1. Open the work order's Finance tab.
2. Click Create Invoice, complete the dialog, and save.
expected: The invoice is created successfully and appears on the Finance tab.
